title: Preserve compiler inputs with owned property-query observations
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Connect the compiler/view preservation construction to the actual candidate loader, parent association, supervisor, native observer, strict receiver and private-view entry. Compiler reports now have owned capture, terminal/error/cleanup evidence and independent readback; launch binding reobserves the actual selected inputs. Bare linker-script operands now preserve script-directory and original-CWD precedence.

The argument compares the **same patched Ubuntu GCC/binutils subject** before and after the selected private view, preserving the original observation projection. Its explicit model includes Linux 6.12 native LP64 x86-64 and the additional security, configuration, filesystem and currentness premises recorded in the proof. Those premises remain qualification obligations.

This is a **candidate-source archive with a conditional proof argument**, independently reviewed by a separate AI agent. It is not a human or proof-kernel certificate, current-host qualification, complete fresh comparison, performance result, multiplication-bound improvement or selected-frontier adoption. The fresh baseline transfer and complete comparison executor remain unimplemented in the current candidate controller. Scope is refined to make those boundaries explicit; the original equality criterion is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Continues the original caller investigation in #6321 and fixed scientific reference #6029. Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.

The existing source and applicable failure controls were reused or adapted rather than replaced by another detached helper:

| #6434 | `edc2820ba023b804ef1351a88e2fe31bf8d489dd` | Preserve raw first-error custody and specs frontier |
| #6454 | `e83090c937b920affc87593f02b535e6c9773615` | Review-only generator/phase precedent; no inherited qualification |

All-author, all-state bounded searches covered the affected binutils/query/parent interfaces and failure behavior. Related heads were refreshed before publication; PR status or green CI alone was not accepted as integration evidence. Exact decisions and exclusions are in `research/h25-caller-proof-completion/PROVENANCE.json`.

## Validation

Retained guarded outcomes, without rerunning unchanged controls:

- Parent: **27/27 normal and 27/27 optimized**; loader: **11/11**; query owner: **38/38**.
- Three native owners compiled successfully without running their mains; the distinct mock observer harness passed **23 literal cases**.
- After the linker-context correction, **8/8 new cases in each Python mode** passed. The old resolver's successful wrong-prefix result remains the regression discriminator.
- The first connected-source operation measured **4.97 s** guard-process wall time; the later regression operation measured **0.91 s**. These are control-operation measurements, not a speedup or complete physical cost.
- Compilation warnings remain in raw logs, including guardian format-truncation warnings. No real property query or original scientific invocation ran.
- A necessary release/architecture screen returned **`7.0.0-42-generic x86_64`**, outside the proof's Linux 6.12 class. Full execution remains on hold.

The archive retains both 196-member original scientific stage maps unchanged, exact source/path/hash/mode mappings, source/patch inputs, the Pro construction, final source review, its explicit comparison-owner boundary, failed versions and raw control evidence. It uses ordered content-addressed archive parts and inert readable source copies. From `research/h25-caller-proof-completion`, the passive reproduction command is:

```sh
python3 -I -B verify_integrity.py
```

The publication receipt records the exact guarded integrity command actually executed and its result. This checker hashes source bytes and archive members; it never extracts files, imports a candidate or runs native/scientific work. This is deliberately not an opt-in executable research replay. Hosted planning and replay outcomes will be reported against the actual submitted head.

Original runtime authority, source/image/configuration facts and historical absolute-path dependencies remain external; the archive is not a portable executable installation or a claim of complete predecessor source history. Policy debits do not close complete physical costs: preparation, Pro, review, reporting, publication, final metadata and historical gaps remain **OPEN_NOT_ZERO**.

## Credit

Credit ChrisR / Clear1nsight, Douglas R. Colkitt, repository contributors, the preceding PR authors, unpaidmoon and Cursor-Grok's cleanup work, and GNU/Debian/Ubuntu source authors. Original source headers and GPL/LGPL texts are retained; third-party material is not relicensed. Substantial construction assistance came from ChatGPT Pro; implementation/assembly used OpenAI Codex with separate AI source review.

## Open next questions

See `research/h25-caller-proof-completion/NEXT.md`. The immediate blocker is an actual source-associated environment satisfying the explicit proof premises, or a separately reviewed model extension. Independently, implement the genuine guarded fresh baseline transfer and complete typed comparison owner. Then close source/image/configuration, full resource/funding and original admission gates before executing and independently checking the complete unchanged baseline/candidate schedule. This PR grants none of those later permissions or results.
